description: Full register record for one Finnish company by businessId (Y-tunnus, format NNNNNNN-N). e.g. {businessId:"0112038-9"} (Nokia Oyj). Returns names[] (with history), addresses[], companyForms[], mainBusinessLine, registeredEntries[], tradeRegisterStatus, status, registrationDate, lastModified. Multi-language descriptions: languageCode 1=Finnish, 2=Swedish, 3=English.
name: get_company
title: Get Company
